_doc: ERA-2 fake TV-evangelist 'testimony' INFOMERCIAL — an interrupt that surfaces after the first Restorify realignment. Dark mirror of TRANSCENDANCE; prototype for its canvas. A real scripted infomercial: a storyline with named composite 'voices' (PASTOR DALE the host, MARCUS a 'graduate', an ANNOUNCER, a CROWD) staged as shots. ALL copy PLACEHOLDER pending Sérgio's argumentation pass + trans/detrans/religious-trauma reader pass. Satire targets the SELLER's salesmanship ONLY, never queer people / survivors / the composite 'testimony'. Invented ministry/brand/number/people — no real orgs/likenesses/verbatim testimony. Real apparatus echoed (1998 'Truth in Love'; Robert Tilton 'Success-N-Life') documented in docs/ERA2_EVANGELIST_COMMERCIAL_SCRIPT_2026-06-30.md, [VERIFY SOURCE]. Voices (jingle + VO) are external bundled audio, TODO — the dialogue below is what they get timed to; per-scene 'at' seconds are the sync points, RETIMED later when Sérgio's song lands (§7b-§7d of the audio production guide) — drive all timing from this data, never hardcode it.
